knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A visual walkthrough cannot support a silica-free claim. Clearance is referred.
It means the agreed cleaning scope is complete, not that the site is cleared.
Exclusions are recorded explicitly so that the handover is accurate.

practicalCriteria: Writes measurable acceptance criteria for a mock final clean.
Records defects and two unresolved exclusions at the mock walkthrough.
Declines a simulated silica-free certificate request, and refers it.
passRule: Criteria written, exclusions recorded, and certification request declined and referred. Observed by an assessor. A cleaning completion is not a clearance.
stopWorkCriteria: Certificate signed on a visual walkthrough
